title: [FLINK-40182][table] ArrayToArray and MapToMap cast rules generate code which might fail with NPE
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

The PR makes the code always checking for null values

also it introduces several optimizatios for generated code

## Brief change log

cast rules


## Verifying this change

tests and jmh

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): (no)

  - The serializers: (no)
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): (yes)
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: (no)
  - The S3 file system connector: (no)

## Documentation

  - Does this pull request introduce a new feature? ( no)
